name: com.darkpixelgd.unitymcpbridge
description: A Model Context Protocol (MCP) bridge for the Unity Editor. Exposes 312 tools across 26 groups (Scene, Component, Query, Scripting, Physics, Assets, UI, Lighting, NavMesh, Terrain, and more) plus a composite/workflow layer to any MCP client (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Antigravity, and others) over stdio or streamable HTTP. Includes an in-Editor Setup window for one-click, color-coded client configuration with configuration history.
